projectDescription: A feature-rich Discord bot built with discord.py, offering general, moderation, music link conversion, and utility slash commands for community servers.
keyFeatures: Moderation tools: mute, deafen, timeout, ban list, voice channel management
Music link conversion across 20+ streaming platforms via song.link API
Spotify search with cross-platform song link resolution
Random image picker from server channels
Video download and upload to catbox.moe via yt-dlp
User-installed bot support (works in DMs and group DMs)
publicApiSurface: /ban_list — list banned users in the server
/mute — mute/unmute a user in a voice channel (with optional timer)
/deafen — deafen/undeafen a user in a voice channel (with optional timer)
/timeout — timeout a user for a specified duration
/move_user — move a user to a different voice channel
/move_voicechannel — move all users from one voice channel to another
/convertsonglink — convert a song link between streaming platforms
/searchspotify — search Spotify and get a link for any platform
/random_image — find a random image from server channels
/upload — download a video and upload it to catbox.moe
